assumptions: Host behavior matches cited documentation and source revisions of 2026-10-24; users invoke skills; alpha users accept renamed invocations announced in release notes.
compatibility: Plugin MCP schema agent-braid-plugin/v0.1 to v0.2 (prompts removed) and renamed plugin skills in 0.1.0-alpha.4; unchanged plugin id, server key, tool names, resource schemes, registry v0.2, agent-braid-tooling/v0.1, SPEC-041/042 legacy installs and SPEC-047 v1 telemetry.
domain: Agent Braid native plugin 0.1.0-alpha.3 and its planned 0.1.0-alpha.4 package on Codex and Claude Code; portable and legacy surfaces only as unchanged regression boundaries.
execution_contract: No execution path, grant, effect or runtime authority changes; analysis-only fixtures suffice; native sessions are owner-run.
hypotheses: Not applicable: engineering specification without empirical hypothesis.
observation_contract: Built package manifests, skill inventory and SDK client listings in owned fixtures; native host listings recorded separately with environment and limits.

scenarios.given: the research record and the naming-policy contract
scenarios.planned_evidence: Candidate-bound procedure_001 record: command, hashes, environment, expected and actual outcome, negative controls and limits.
scenarios.then: every rule names its source class (normative, convention, observed or owner decision), no rule contradicts a cited normative requirement, and host differences (tool-id sanitization, prompt support, server-key scoping) are explicit.
scenarios.when: the policy is reviewed against the cited MCP, Agent Skills, Claude Code and Codex sources

requirements.text: Naming policy and research record: Publish one naming policy covering all plugin surfaces on both hosts, with each rule traced to a cited normative source, a convention or an owner decision.

scenarios.planned_evidence: Candidate-bound procedure_002 record: command, hashes, environment, expected and actual outcome, negative controls and limits.
scenarios.then: the plugin and marketplace names are `agent-braid`, the server key is `agent-braid`, and the tool names are exactly `analyze-work`, `analyze`, `prepare`, `status`, `execute`, `recover`, `verify`, `plugin-status` and `workspaces` (subject to runtime enablement); a renamed key or tool fails the check.
scenarios.when: its Codex and Claude manifests, both marketplaces, `mcp.json`, `.mcp.json` and the plugin MCP tool list are inspected

requirements.text: Stable identifiers: Keep the plugin identifier, marketplace entry names, MCP server key and MCP tool names unchanged.

scenarios.given: a plugin MCP connection with two registered workspaces
scenarios.planned_evidence: Candidate-bound procedure_003 record: command, hashes, environment, expected and actual outcome, negative controls and limits.
scenarios.then: the server capabilities omit prompts, the listing is empty or the method is not supported, the request is refused without side effects, and per-workspace `capabilities` resources no longer list prompts; tools and resources behave as before.
scenarios.when: the client initializes, lists prompts and requests `agent-braid-analyze`

requirements.text: No MCP prompts from the plugin server: The plugin MCP server advertises no prompts capability and returns no prompts.

scenarios.given: the canonical skill sources and a built plugin
scenarios.planned_evidence: Candidate-bound procedure_004 record: command, hashes, environment, expected and actual outcome, negative controls and limits.
scenarios.then: each directory equals its frontmatter `name`, every name satisfies the Agent Skills name rules, the bodies equal the canonical bodies except for the declared name and cross-reference substitutions, no `agent-braid-` skill token remains in packaged skills, and the package inventory records the canonical source hash and the substitution table.

requirements.text: Unprefixed plugin skill names: Package the plugin skills as `analyze`, `plan`, `evidence`, `execute`, `recover` and `setup`, with directory names equal to the `name` field and sibling-skill references rewritten to the plugin names.

scenarios.given: the portable server and a legacy receipt install
scenarios.planned_evidence: Candidate-bound procedure_005 record: command, hashes, environment, expected and actual outcome, negative controls and limits.
scenarios.then: they equal the `agent-braid-tooling/v0.1` and SPEC-041/042 contracts, including the three `agent-braid-*` prompts and the prefixed global skill directories.
scenarios.when: prompts, tools, capabilities and installed skill paths are listed

requirements.text: Legacy and portable surfaces unchanged: Keep the portable MCP server, its prompts and the receipt-owned global skill install byte- and name-compatible.

scenarios.given: an `0.1.0-alpha.3` installation with a v0.2 registry and existing results
scenarios.planned_evidence: Candidate-bound procedure_006 record: command, hashes, environment, expected and actual outcome, negative controls and limits.
scenarios.then: the registry and results survive, the old prompt and prefixed plugin skills are no longer listed, the new skills are listed, existing permission rules for plugin tools keep matching, release notes name every removed and renamed invocation, and reinstalling `0.1.0-alpha.3` restores the old names without registry changes.
scenarios.when: the plugin is updated natively to the candidate on each host

requirements.text: Versioned migration: Version the change as plugin MCP schema `agent-braid-plugin/v0.2` in plugin `0.1.0-alpha.4`, with a documented migration and rollback and no aliases.

scenarios.planned_evidence: Candidate-bound procedure_007 record: command, hashes, environment, expected and actual outcome, negative controls and limits.
scenarios.then: recorded operations stay within `analyze-work`, `analyze`, `prepare`, `status`, `execute`, `recover`, `verify` and `other`, no prompt traffic is counted, and the batch schema and store version are unchanged.
scenarios.when: every delegated tool and the removed prompt request are exercised

requirements.text: Telemetry contract unchanged: Preserve the SPEC-047 `mcp` operation enum and batch contract.

scenarios.planned_evidence: Candidate-bound procedure_008 record: command, hashes, environment, expected and actual outcome, negative controls and limits.
scenarios.then: installation docs show `/agent-braid:<skill>` (Claude Code) and the Codex skill mention form, tool references use bare MCP tool names, and no document claims Codex displays MCP prompts.
scenarios.when: they are searched for invocation names and tool references

requirements.text: Documentation and host-neutral references: Update English documentation and skill text so tool references do not assume one host's qualified tool id.

scenarios.given: a source-bound candidate installed natively at user scope
scenarios.planned_evidence: Candidate-bound procedure_009 record: command, hashes, environment, expected and actual outcome, negative controls and limits.
scenarios.then: the observed names match the policy and the outcome, environment and limits are recorded separately from package checks.
scenarios.when: each host lists its skills and MCP prompts and runs the analyze skill on a registered fixture

requirements.text: Native host observation: Observe the candidate in real Codex and Claude Code user profiles before release.

scientific_limits: Engineering naming policy; no scientific claim. Documentation and source reading are not native observation; structural checks are not owner approval.
scope: Naming policy for native plugin surfaces in Codex and Claude Code: plugin id, marketplace, MCP server key and identity, tools, prompts, resources and skills, with alpha migration and telemetry impact. Specification only.
